about: The first prednisolone supply specifies maintenance treatment for documented moderate to severe COPD, and the record contains no inhaled steroid.

Possible finding: the record holds no line about COPD. Panafcortelone (prednisolone) is supplied monthly by brand name only for six months from January 2026, with an Atrovent (ipratropium) inhaler that suggests a lung condition and no inhaled steroid.
Moderate to severe COPD is documented and there is no inhaled steroid, but prednisolone was supplied only as two separate five-day courses.
